What Is Ashiatsu Massage?

Ashiatsu is a barefoot technique that applies broad, steady pressure. Your therapist explains positioning and builds pressure gradually around your comfort.

Ashiatsu massage in Bellevue

This approach may appeal to guests who enjoy deeper pressure distributed across a broader area. Share medical concerns, recent injuries or sensitivity before treatment so the therapist can determine whether the technique is appropriate.

For targeted hand-applied work, see deep tissue massage, or browse all services.

Frequently Asked Questions

How is Ashiatsu different from deep tissue massage?

Ashiatsu uses the therapist’s feet for broad pressure; deep tissue massage generally uses hands, forearms or elbows for more localized work.

Can pressure be adjusted?

Yes. Pressure is introduced gradually and should remain within your comfortable range.

Is Ashiatsu right for everyone?

Not always. Tell us about pregnancy, recent injury, surgery or health concerns before booking so appropriateness can be discussed.
